objectives.text: Trace which registered route and handler a request reaches, and select the Context call that reads a path parameter, a query parameter or a JSON body
Write and register a GET or POST handler that sets the status and returns JSON, and pass its public check in the required guided local run
Map an exception to a status code and JSON body with an exception handler, and pass its public check in the required guided local run

minutes.basis: Measured in the http-and-javalin module PR on the authored artifact.html with the frozen authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py (sha256 0deca96bf5e367aeae51a82abdbd4b6ce0d0289ecc9868c9eff3701016edf96f): modeledP50 9.25 (1020 words, 16 code lines, interactions {"confidence": 2, "drag": 1, "explore": 2, "mcq": 1, "predict": 1}). modeledWorstPath 15.0 = P50 plus the worst required route per interactive unit: the predict unit +0.25 min (reading every option's explanation); each Context-call sort item +1 min (two wrong tries, then the revealed explanation, 4 item(s)); the POST-handler editor unit +1.5 min (typing a block handler, then two runs that fail to compile or answer with the wrong status or body before both requests behave); the exception-handler editor unit +1.5 min (typing an exception handler, then two runs that answer 500 or a text body before both requests behave); the apply check +1.5 min (two wrong graded attempts, reading the retry representation and both feedback sets). Budget and aboutLabel are ceil(max(P50, worst path)) under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md, raised from the intake planning value 15 and within the 15-minute cap.
